title: File:The Scientific balloon eclipses the sun as it fills with helium, and the High Altitude Student Platform awaits launch (GSFC2024HASP0202).jpg
art: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / Sophia Roberts
desc: The Scientific balloon eclipses the sun as it fills with helium, and the High Altitude Student Platform awaits launch. On August 28, 2024, the student-run mission launched from a 4-million-cubic-foot balloon for its second flight.
